body:
Riley (AE): Heads-up — working a POC with MeridianPay (fintech). They want a 90-day technical POC but have two asks: data residency in eu-west-1 and a short SOC2 evidence check before we let them send sensitive test payloads. Also asking if we can front-load credits for bursts during test month.

Priya (AM): Nice. Do we know expected usage shape? burst vs steady?

Riley (AE): Eliot ran an early sim — estimate: 500k tokens/mo typical, spike to ~1.2M in month 1 for end-to-end testing. Mix of embeddings + gen calls.

Eliot (SE): Confirmed. Workload is embeddings-heavy for bank-statement parsing + chat flows. Latency SLOs matter; they want dedicated-ish predictability for the POC window.

Riley (AE): They're in an accelerator but not one of our standard startup partners. Asking for promotional credits to cover month 1 burst and partial month 2/3. I flagged normal startup playbook but they don't qualify. Can Deal Desk do a one-off promo?

DealDeskBot: New approval request created: DD-4321 — MeridianPay POC credits + residency. Link: https://redwood.com/internal/deals/DD-4321

Sam (RevOps): Need the ask spelled out. Proposed terms?

Riley (AE): Proposed terms (quick):
```
- POC length: 90 days (3 months)
- Usage baseline: 500k tokens / month
- Month 1 burst coverage: up to 1.2M tokens
- Promo credits: 6k USD applied as credits month 1 (covers burst), 2k USD month 2, 1k USD month 3
- No long-term commit or minimum beyond POC
- Data residency: restrict endpoints to eu-west-1 (private endpoint handed to customer)
- Security gating: provide SOC2 Type II evidence within 10 business days; redact if needed
- Legal: standard DPA + PII minimization clause during POC
```

Priya (AM): From AM POV — we need a conditional: credits apply only after SOC2 evidence is submitted or after a signed attestation form. Otherwise we can only allow synthetic data in burst tests.

Eliot (SE): Technical note: we can provision a private VPC-only private deployment for the POC but that becomes a Private deployment request (ops lead time ~5 business days). Alternatively, a region-restricted hosted endpoint with ACLs could work faster.

Sam (RevOps): Numbers look reasonable. What's the ARR upside? If they convert to paid in 6 months with commit, what revenue do we expect?

Riley (AE): If they convert, likely start with a reserved pool around 3M tokens/mo => estimated $8-12k/mo rev depending on plan. Risk is small vs product-led conversion.

LegalOps: We need to review the SOC2 evidence and sign off on redaction rules. Also want to add a clause: "Credits void if PII/exhaustive customer data used before SOC2 clearance."

Sam (RevOps): I'd approve a capped promo credit of $6k upfront + $3k spread over months 2-3 (total $9k) conditional on LegalOps sign-off and SOC2 attestation within 10 business days. If no SOC2, credits revert and we invoice consumed tokens at list rates.

DealDeskBot: DD-4321 updated — preliminary approval by Sam (RevOps) for $9k total credits conditional on LegalOps SOC2 clause. Awaiting LegalOps final text.

LegalOps: I can draft the clause this afternoon. Quick Q: do we want to add an explicit data retention window for POC logs? Recommend 30 days by default.

Priya (AM): Yes 30 days retention is fine. Also want a short ROI checkpoint at day 45 to see conversion signal.

Riley (AE): Great — I'll update the deal doc with these conditions and ping MeridianPay to get SOC2 evidence request in flight. Thanks everyone :pray::rocket:

Eliot (SE): FYI — if they ask for a private deploy, ping me asap. We can fast-track infra but needs early notice.

DealDeskBot: DD-4321 status: Pending LegalOps. Last update 1767123520.
